Theme

skate verb

also skating, go skating, ice-skate, roller-skate

modern

Traupman 49, 331: (per glaciem) patināre
Traupman 380: (rotulīs) patināre
Traupman 48

patinō, patināre

verb, first conjugation

skate (on ice or on roller skates)

Traupman’s verb, made on his patinus, an ice skate (see ice skates); classical Latin has no word for skating. Skating is patinātiō, a skater patinātor (Traupman 49).

Other words

  • soleā ferreā lūdere — skate on ice

    phrase · also used · modern · M-O s.v. skate: ice-skater (Egger)

    A description on Egger’s solea ferrea, an ice skate.

See also ice skates, roller skates, skateboard.
